defmodule PdfGen.TemplateEngine do @moduledoc "Multi-tenant PDF generation with template support" @allowed_directives ~w(page_break header footer watermark) @max_template_size 65_536 defstruct [:tenant_id, :template_body, :variables, :output_path] def render(%__MODULE__{} = ctx) do with :ok <- validate_tenant(ctx.tenant_id), :ok <- validate_size(ctx.template_body), {:ok, processed} <- process_template(ctx) do generate_pdf(processed, ctx) end end defp validate_tenant(tenant_id) when is_binary(tenant_id) do if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-z0-9_-]{3,32}$/, tenant_id), do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_tenant} end defp validate_tenant(_), do: {:error, :invalid_tenant} defp validate_size(body) when byte_size(body) <= @max_template_size, do: :ok defp validate_size(_), do: {:error, :template_too_large} defp process_template(%__MODULE__{template_body: body, variables: vars, tenant_id: tid}) do body |> resolve_variables(vars, tid) |> resolve_directives(tid) |> resolve_includes(tid) end defp resolve_variables(body, vars, tenant_id) when is_map(vars) do Enum.reduce(vars, body, fn {key, value}, acc -> safe_value = sanitize_variable(value, tenant_id) String.replace(acc, "{{#{key}}}", safe_value) end) end defp resolve_variables(body, _, _), do: body defp sanitize_variable(value, _tenant_id) when is_binary(value) do value |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end defp sanitize_variable(value, _) when is_number(value), do: to_string(value) defp sanitize_variable(_, _), do: "" defp resolve_directives(body, _tenant_id) do Regex.replace(~r//, body, fn full_match, directive, params -> if directive in @allowed_directives do apply_directive(directive, parse_params(params)) else "" end end) end defp resolve_includes(body, tenant_id) do Regex.replace(~r//, body, fn _, path -> load_tenant_include(path, tenant_id) end) end defp load_tenant_include(path, tenant_id) do normalized = normalize_path(path) base_dir = tenant_base_path(tenant_id) full_path = Path.join(base_dir, normalized) # Verify the resolved path is within tenant boundary if path_within_boundary?(full_path, base_dir) do case File.read(full_path) do {:ok, content} -> content {:error, _} -> "" end else "" end end defp normalize_path(path) do path |> String.trim_leading("/") |> Path.expand() |> String.trim_leading("/") end defp path_within_boundary?(full_path, base_dir) do String.starts_with?(Path.expand(full_path), Path.expand(base_dir)) end defp tenant_base_path(tenant_id) do Path.join(["/var/lib/pdfgen/tenants", tenant_id, "includes"]) end defp apply_directive("page_break", _), do: "
" defp apply_directive("header", params), do: "
#{Map.get(params, "text", "")}
" defp apply_directive("footer", params), do: "
#{Map.get(params, "text", "")}
" defp apply_directive("watermark", params), do: "
#{Map.get(params, "text", "")}
" defp apply_directive(_, _), do: "" defp parse_params(params_str) do Regex.scan(~r/(\w+)="([^"]*)"/, params_str) |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn [_, key, value], acc -> Map.put(acc, key, value) end) end defp generate_pdf(html_content, %__MODULE__{output_path: output_path, tenant_id: tid}) do safe_output = Path.join(["/var/lib/pdfgen/output", tid, output_path]) # Uses wkhtmltopdf under the hood PdfGen.Renderer.html_to_pdf(html_content, safe_output) end end defmodule PdfGen.Renderer do def html_to_pdf(html, output_path) do tmp_file = Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "pdf_#{:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.hex_encode32()}.html") File.write!(tmp_file, html) result = System.cmd("wkhtmltopdf", ["--disable-javascript", "--disable-local-file-access", tmp_file, output_path]) File.rm(tmp_file) case result do {_, 0} -> {:ok, output_path} {err, _} -> {:error, err} end end end
